direction: Dynamic static app icon: countersteer, swinging tail, curved tire marks, small smoke puffs and speed strokes.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final square mobile parking-game app icon, one image, 1:1, target 1024×1024.
Input image: the existing orange-car logo is an EDIT TARGET and brand identity reference. Completely redesign its composition and pose to make it exciting and dynamic. Preserve the recognizable orange compact car, dark teal glass, warm yellow / ink-black / cream palette and thick cartoon outlines.
User feedback: the previous logo feels static and unappealing. The new logo MUST feel like a freeze-frame from a lively cartoon animation, visibly in motion, immediately engaging at a tiny app-icon size.
Primary scene: a chunky orange compact car abruptly swinging its tail into a white parking bay, mid-turn, front wheels visibly countersteering. Dynamic overhead THREE-QUARTER view with a little visible side-body depth, a low squat silhouette, lively suspension lean, strong foreshortening. The nose thrusts toward the upper right while the rear sweeps left; capture a coherent single turn, not a parked diagonal car. Keep all four wheels and the full car silhouette readable. The hero car fills about two thirds of the frame.
Motion: two sweeping curved dark skid marks follow the rear tires into the turn, compact cream smoke puffs close to the rear wheels, and a few tapered orange/cream speed strokes pulling outward behind the tail. These motion shapes form one bold sweeping diagonal/S composition, with the car sharply outlined and the action readable at 64 pixels. One parking bay partly visible behind and beneath the moving car, rotated in perspective. No enclosing U-shaped static frame.
Style: premium energetic cartoon game-key-art logo, confident ink contour, punchy shapes, crisp cel-shaded orange body, bright windshield gleam, dramatic hard shadow, warm yellow full-bleed backdrop with a simple directional burst. Express animation through pose, arcs, overlapping shapes and controlled exaggeration. Make it more charming and more physically lively than the original. Not a realistic 3D render.
Composition: strong center of gravity, 8% outer safe margin, no rounded outer clipping, no border, no presentation mockup. One car only. Very limited detail so it remains a strong icon.
Remove the old question mark. No letters, no words, no numbers, no logo text. No tanks, no weapons, no iron weights, no human faces, no racing flags, no photorealism, no explosion, no airborne stunt, no extra cars, no large smoke cloud hiding the car, no watermark. Opaque background.
export: Proportional resizing to 1024px with sips; source retained.
